title: Concept: Conan lockfile pins a package reference without a recipe revision
description: conan.lock declares a locked reference that omits the recipe revision, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Without the revision Conan can resolve a different recipe for the same version, so the lockfile does not freeze the build.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through conan.lock (conan).
risk: Without the revision Conan can resolve a different recipe for the same version, so the lockfile does not freeze the build.
